title: Burns Philp Building, Normanton
axis: Positive X follows Landsborough Street northeast along the facade. Positive Z faces out toward Landsborough Street.
source: OpenStreetMap Normanton Information Centre footprint and Queensland Heritage Register entry 602781

mappedIdentity.name: Burns Philp Building, Normanton
mappedIdentity.address: Corner of Landsborough Street and Caroline Street, Normanton, Queensland, Australia

features.role: Heritage-listed 1884 merchant warehouse now occupied by the visitor information centre and library.

identityStatus: The mapped roof footprint determines the building scale and the lateral position of the covered street edges. The statutory description distinguishes the three parallel bays and the Landsborough Street facade.

terrainContact.basis: Unchanged Copernicus GLO-30 DSM sampled at the Landsborough Street approach in the mapped warehouse frame.

notes: Queensland Heritage Register entry 602781 specifies the raised floor, roof valleys, central ridge ventilators, window and door stations. The original photograph provides the three decorated parapet curves and profile of the projecting street awnings.
